name: Quentin Tarantino
note: All of them, and you love them. Nothing left.

name: Ari Aster
note: Hereditary 4½ and Midsommar 4 are the peak. Beau and Eddington didn't repeat it — useful negative data.

name: Benson & Moorhead
note: All five. Still the strongest completist signal in the account.

name: Christopher Nolan
note: Dunkirk now seen. Only **Following** and **Insomnia** remain — both minor, both short.

name: Denis Villeneuve
note: Enemy seen, rated "good" rather than great. **Prisoners** and **Incendies** left.

name: Yorgos Lanthimos
note: Sacred Deer was "ok" — so it's the comic Lanthimos you like (Poor Things and Bugonia both 4½), not the punishing one. That reorders what's worth trying: **The Favourite** before Kinds of Kindness.

name: David Fincher
note: Four seen and somehow no **Se7en**. The strangest gap on the page.

name: Coen Brothers
note: Eight in. **Inside Llewyn Davis, Barton Fink, Miller's Crossing, Blood Simple.**

name: Bong Joon-ho
note: Two for two, and five films untouched. **Memories of Murder** first. Biggest unclaimed run in the profile.

name: Park Chan-wook
note: Just Oldboy, for years. **The Handmaiden** and **Decision to Leave**.

name: Ingmar Bergman
note: Two films, two perfect scores, and no follow-through yet.

name: Paul Thomas Anderson
note: You rate The Master highly and haven't touched the rest. **There Will Be Blood.**
